whatsNew.summary: Faster Work chat editing while connected sessions report their progress. Compatible with server 6.73.4.

sections.title: Responsive typing
items: Typing updates only the composer. Chat history and file lists stay separate.
Drafts save after a short pause and immediately when you send or leave the view.
Background receipt refreshes keep the editor available.

sections.title: Work chat
items: Describe an outcome and see the plan and affected sessions before their assignments are sent.
Read each session’s delivery status and results together in the task conversation.
Connections and Agent workspace stay available. Shared task completion remains your decision.
Cursor and sessions already handed to a desktop app retain manual continuation.

sections.title: Rich task context
items: Format Work chat with bold, italic, headings and lists. Drafts keep their formatting when you return.
Drop or paste images and media into task attachments. Native assignments carry the saved files and readable companions.
